bifrost: springboard/apps/assistant-desktop (cloud Anthropic client), springboard/sdk/src/url.rs (streaming), springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs (App Intents)
summary: Apple's framework runs an on-device language model (SystemLanguageModel) with sessions, guided generation, tool calling and an optional Private Cloud Compute model. BifrOSt has no on-device model and no SDK API for model sessions, structured generation or model-invoked tools. Its only AI feature is the Assistant app, which calls a cloud Anthropic API over streaming HTTPS, and the SDK has App Intents and URLSession streaming that such a feature could use.

gaps: No on-device language model and no SDK API for it: an app cannot ask the system for text generation without a network call.
No model session type with instructions, prompts, generation options and streamed partial output.
No guided generation: model output cannot be constrained to a typed schema.
No model-invoked tool calling; App Intents (springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs) exist but are not exposed to a model.
No context window or token budget API, and no transcript type shared across apps.
The Assistant (springboard/apps/assistant-desktop) is a cloud client for the Anthropic API, not an on-device or Apple-equivalent feature, so it does not count as parity.
